Photorealistic 16:9 cinematic still, modern sun-soaked lifestyle beauty campaign with clean true-to-life color, crisp whites, airy lifted shadows and a slight warmth in the highlights. SCARLETT (Image 1) wears a black long-sleeve rash vest as a swim top, soaked and clinging in wet folds, no jewelry or styled beachwear. Starting frame: she has just broken the surface of a Bondi wave, mid-blink, the back of her wrist raised to wipe salt from her eyes without ever going near her mouth, a smaller slap of whitewater catching her shoulder as she twists and begins wading toward shore, water sheeting off the rashie, the turn still coiled with leftover surge. Wide Bondi shoreline at morning stretching either side: coarse pale sand, receding foam lace on the wet grit, a dumped tote sitting above the wash, open green-blue ocean rolling into broken whitewater, pale sky and only the faintest haze of distant headlands, no buildings in frame. Hard overhead beach sun on wet fabric and hanging salt spray, sparkling bounce from the water, bright specular hits on every ripple, fine mist backlit into glitter, high-key coastal light with punchy contrast in the spray. Handheld waterline three-quarter, about 35mm, shallow depth of field locking SCARLETT (Image 1) sharp while the long shoreline falls into soft bokeh, tactile editorial freeze of a single unposed instant.
